svg.title: Tunisie interlock network

g.text: Cie Fermière des chemins de fer tun…

svg.text: 29 firms in 11 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 130 firms, 295 interlocks, 12 components (largest 101). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 40 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
